# AGENTS.md — `AGEINT/tests/fixtures`

Parity fixture data for AGEINT tests.

## Layout
- `risk_category_parity.json`, `topic_prompt_parity.json`, `topic_rotation_parity.json` — fixture datasets used by parity/rotation tests (generated by `scripts/generate_*_fixture.py`).

## Gotchas
- Regenerate fixtures with the generator scripts rather than hand-editing, so tests stay aligned with live data.
- AGEINT is a public repository (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20732274); its contents are committed here.
